name: LandSignal
install:
cd apps/web && npm ci
cd apps/api && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -U pip -q && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' -q

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Next.js web UI — Cursor auto-forwards port 3000 into the right-side browser

terminals.name: api
terminals.command: cd apps/api && set -a && [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a && AUTO_DISCOVER_ON_STARTUP=false LAND_ALERTS_MONITOR_ENABLED=false .venv/bin/uvicorn landsignal.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
terminals.description: API behind Next /v1 rewrite on port 8000
